The role

As a Clinical Associate, you sit within Customer Success at the centre of clinician adoption. Your remit is to ensure that clinicians and healthcare organisations derive immediate, tangible value from Heidi by embedding it into day-to-day clinical practice with precision and minimal friction.

This is a deeply operational, clinician-facing role. You will work directly with end users to understand how care is delivered in practice, and then translate those workflows into effective Heidi usage. That includes configuring templates, shaping documentation outputs, and aligning the product to the realities of different specialties, settings, and consultation styles. You will be heavily involved in onboarding and implementation across a range of customer segments, with particular focus on enterprise deployments.

A significant component of the role is in-person delivery. You will regularly travel to customer sites to support rollouts, deliver training, and work directly with clinical teams during critical adoption phases. This on-the-ground presence is essential in driving momentum, resolving friction in real time, and ensuring that Heidi is embedded effectively across organisations.

It’s a perfect role for an enterprising, bright, and gritty current or former clinician looking to break into the health-tech space.

What you’ll do

Implementation & onboarding support

  • Support smooth onboarding of Heidi across new and existing customers, partnering closely with Customer Success Managers and Clinical Template Officers.

  • Contribute to rollout planning by supporting discovery sessions, gathering documentation examples, and clarifying clinician workflows.

  • Deliver and support training sessions for clinicians and operational staff, both live and asynchronously.

  • Provide hands-on support during go-lives and early usage, especially where clinician documentation requirements are the blocker.

Clinical workflow & medical knowledge enablement

  • Develop a strong understanding of Heidi and how clinicians use it across different specialties and care settings.

  • Translate real-world clinical workflows into best-practice guidance that helps clinicians embed Heidi into daily practice.

  • Act as a trusted clinical voice for users, answering questions and helping them understand how to get the best outcomes from Heidi.

Templates: discovery & support

  • Support the template discovery process by collecting examples, understanding documentation needs, and clearly documenting requirements.

  • Triage incoming template-related questions and recommend the right next step (reuse, small edits, or escalation).

  • Make small, high-impact template adjustments (e.g. structure, phrasing, configuration guidance) to unblock onboarding and early adoption.

  • Maintain simple, scalable guidance (how-to notes, examples, do’s and don’ts) that enables Customer Success to self-serve common questions.

Continuous improvement & collaboration

  • Capture and synthesise feedback from clinicians to improve onboarding playbooks, training materials, and template guidance.

  • Partner with Product, Support, and Engineering to share insights from the field and help improve workflows and tooling over time.

  • Contribute to evolving team processes that help Heidi scale implementation and clinical enablement.

What we’re looking for

  • Early-career or recently practicing clinical professionals (medical, nursing, allied health, mental health).

  • Strong interest in healthtech, AI, and improving clinical workflows.

  • Clear, confident communicator with the ability to explain clinical concepts simply and practically.

  • Organised and reliable, able to manage multiple onboarding tasks and support requests.

  • Comfortable learning new tools and working in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment.

  • Proactive, curious, and motivated to make clinicians’ working lives easier.

  • Experience with AI tools, CRMs or customer support platforms is helpful but not required. Attitude, clinical insight, and willingness to learn matter most.

What success looks like

  • Clinicians feel confident using Heidi early in their journey.

  • Onboardings run smoothly with fewer workflow or documentation blockers.

  • Customer Success teams are able to self-serve common clinical and template questions.

  • Enablement materials and guidance improve continuously through real-world feedback.

What do we believe in?

Heidi builds for the future of healthcare, not just the next quarter, and our goals are ambitious because the world’s health demands it. We believe in progress built through precision, pace, and ownership.

  • Live Forever - Every release moves care forward: measured, safe, and built to last. Data guides us, but patients define the truth that matters.

  • Practice Ownership - Decisions follow logic and proof, not hierarchy. Exceptional care demands exceptional standards in our work, our thinking, and our character.

  • Small Cuts Heal Faster - Stability earns trust, speed delivers impact. Progress is about learning fast without breaking what people depend on.

  • Make others better - Feedback is direct, kindness is constant, and excellence lifts everyone. Our success is measured by collective growth, not individual output.

Our mission is clear: expand the world’s capacity to care, and do it without losing the humanity that makes care worth delivering.

Why you should Join Heidi

  • Real product momentum. We’re not trying to generate interest, we’re channeling it. This is a rare chance to create a global impact as you immerse yourself in Australia’s fastest growing start-up.

  • Equity from day one. When Heidi wins, you win. You’ll share directly in the success you help create.

  • Unmatched impact. Play a pivotal role at a critical growth moment - all while working on a product that delivers tangible value to clinicians and patients every day.

  • Work alongside world-class talent. Join a team of operators and builders who’ve scaled unicorns.

  • Global reach. Help shape our international expansion as we bring Heidi to key international markets.

  • Growth and balance. Enjoy a personal development budget, dedicated wellness days, subsidised gym membership, and your birthday off to recharge.

  • Flexibility that works. A hybrid environment, with 3 days in the office.

Heidi’s commitment to Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

Heidi is dedicated to creating an equitable, inclusive, and supportive work environment that brings people together from diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. Our strength is in our differences. We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are proud to welcome all applicants as we're committed to promoting a culture of opportunity for all.

Help us reimagine primary care and change the face of healthcare in Australia and then around the world.

Own your commercial pipeline

Manage a high-volume portfolio with rigour

  • Own approximately 50 accounts simultaneously. Operate with a clear prioritisation model that keeps at-risk accounts protected, healthy accounts growing, and no account left unattended.

  • Build and execute account-specific success plans that map customer goals to measurable outcomes, reviewed at predictable cadences.

  • Run high-quality QBRs that quantify value delivered, surface the next commercial opportunity, and create exec-level alignment.

Drive adoption and outcomes

  • Take accounts from pilot through full deployment, leading implementation coordination, training waves, and clinical workflow integration.

  • Use usage data and adoption signals to intervene early - before a customer knows they have a problem. Translate data into clear, customer-ready narratives.

  • Apply structured change management: training cadences, competency checks, and workflow reinforcement - to move clinicians from activation to habit.

  • Work with Customer Success Associates where available, providing clear direction and maintaining full accountability for outcomes.

Manage risk proactively

  • Identify churn risk from leading indicators - usage drop, stakeholder change, disengagement, competitive noise - not from NPS surveys or lagging signals.

  • Surface risk early internally with a clear diagnosis and a plan, not just a flag.

  • Own recovery plans for at-risk accounts and execute them without waiting for escalation.

Collaborate and contribute

  • Maintain a tight, professional working relationship with your AE counterpart. Align on account strategy, share intelligence, and move in the same direction commercially.

  • Advocate for customer needs internally with clarity, evidence, and prioritisation - not volume.

  • Contribute to playbooks, commercial frameworks, and team knowledge that make the wider CS team sharper.

  • Commercial track record in SaaS: 3–5+ years in a customer success or commercial account management role at a B2B SaaS company. You have carried a real quota, managed pipeline, and hit expansion and renewal targets in a multi-stakeholder environment.

  • Multi-product fluency: Experience positioning and expanding across multiple SKUs within an existing customer base. You understand how to sequence a multi-product conversation and build the commercial case for each product.

  • High-volume portfolio management: Comfortable owning a large book of accounts simultaneously without letting anything fall through the cracks. You have a system, and it works.

  • Pipeline discipline: You forecast accurately, update your CRM without being asked, and can walk anyone through your book at any time. Pipeline hygiene is not an admin task for you, it is how you think.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Art Director based in France.

This is a hands-on creative leadership role shaping the complete visual identity of a multiplayer PvPvE shooter built in Unreal Engine.
You’ll own the artistic direction across characters, environments, animation, weapons, concept art, and UI/UX.
Working closely with creative, design, product, and technical teams, you’ll ensure every visual element feels cohesive and supports the player experience.
You’ll lead a multidisciplinary art team while remaining deeply involved in production and asset development.
The role combines high-level artistic vision with practical pipeline, workflow, and production ownership.
As the game moves toward Early Access and live content, you’ll help establish scalable processes for new arenas, seasonal content, cosmetics, and ongoing updates.
You’ll join a distributed, self-managing team that values open collaboration, strong communication, and ambitious game development.


Accountabilities:

  • Own and define the overall art direction, visual identity, and creative standards across the game.

  • Direct the development of environment art, character and species design, animation, modeling, rigging, texturing, shader development, concept art, 2D assets, and UI/UX.

  • Establish clear artistic direction and provide regular feedback to ensure assets remain consistent, polished, and aligned with the game's identity.

  • Maintain a cohesive visual language across playable species, characters, environments, skins, cosmetics, and future content.

  • Partner closely with creative leadership, game designers, technical leaders, and product stakeholders to integrate art seamlessly with gameplay and game design.

  • Build and maintain effective 3D art pipelines within Unreal Engine and collaborate with technical teams to resolve production challenges.

  • Optimize artistic workflows and production processes to balance visual quality, development efficiency, and the pace required for live-service content.

  • Plan, initiate, execute, and control art production from early concepts through release-ready assets and post-launch updates.

  • Track milestones, production progress, and deliverables using tools such as Jira and Confluence.

  • Provide regular feedback, guidance, and support to the art team while keeping production aligned with schedules and quality expectations.

  • Contribute to the development of new arenas, seasonal content, cosmetics, and other post-launch experiences.

  • Work cross-functionally to identify and resolve technical or production challenges that could affect artistic quality or delivery.

  • Help establish an environment where different art disciplines collaborate effectively within an agile and distributed production model.

    • Bachelor's degree in Art, Design, or a closely related discipline, complemented by substantial professional experience in game production.

    • Experience with Jira and Confluence; familiarity with Jira Advanced Roadmaps or Jira Plans is a significant advantage.

data.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Applied ML Engineer based in France.

As an Applied ML Engineer, you’ll work at the intersection of machine learning research, experimentation, and production engineering.
You’ll turn ideas from research papers into rigorous experiments, measurable evidence, and reliable products.
The role spans model evaluation, model internals, inference infrastructure, backend systems, and user-facing product experiences.
You’ll work hands-on with modern ML models, designing evaluations that reveal what methods can—and cannot—demonstrate.
You’ll also build production-grade tooling that makes complex experiments repeatable, observable, and accessible to users.
The environment values technical judgment, ownership, scientific rigor, and the ability to move comfortably across the technology stack.
It’s an opportunity to help transform emerging ML techniques into practical systems that people can trust.


Accountabilities
  • Reproduce and evaluate machine learning research methods using open-weight and API-accessible models.
  • Design evaluation datasets, probes, scoring approaches, baselines, calibration tests, and experiment harnesses.
  • Work directly with model weights, logits, hidden states, activations, model APIs, and inference infrastructure when required.
  • Build and extend evaluation infrastructure covering experiment runners, judges, persistence, orchestration, reporting, and reproducibility.
  • Turn research workflows into intuitive product experiences, including experiment configuration, execution, traces, comparisons, reports, and review workflows.
  • Investigate how verification methods behave when models are modified through fine-tuning, merging, quantization, distillation, safety removal, or deliberate evasion.
  • Design controlled experiments that distinguish meaningful signals from artifacts, confounders, and misleading correlations.
  • Produce clear technical reports that separate measured evidence from interpretation and hypotheses.
  • Deliver production-quality systems with APIs, asynchronous jobs, databases, observability, testing, deployment, and documentation.
  • Contribute across research, experimentation, engineering, and product as priorities evolve.
  • During the first six months, reproduce and document at least one published model-provenance or verification method, including its capabilities, assumptions, and limitations.
  • Build a repeatable model-verification runner with versioned inputs, artifacts, metrics, and reports, and make at least one verification workflow accessible through the product interface.
  • Run controlled experiments across base, fine-tuned, merged, quantized, and known distilled models, improving understanding of when verification methods succeed, fail, and why.

    • Requirements:

    • Strong Python engineering skills, with hands-on experience using PyTorch and Hugging Face Transformers.
    • Solid understanding of machine learning evaluation, including dataset design, baselines, metrics, calibration, false positives and negatives, statistical uncertainty, and reproducibility.
    • Ability to read ML research papers critically and implement methods from first principles rather than relying entirely on existing packages.
    • Professional software engineering experience beyond notebooks, including APIs, asynchronous jobs, databases, logging, testing, deployment, and documentation.
    • Familiarity with open-weight models and a practical understanding of how modern LLM inference systems operate.
    • Ability to work across backend and frontend boundaries, with sufficient React/TypeScript knowledge to help make complex experiments and results understandable to users.
    • Strong experimental and analytical judgment, particularly around distinguishing what evidence demonstrates from what it merely suggests.
    • High ownership and initiative, with the ability to identify problems, propose solutions, and drive projects forward independently.
    • Comfort working in a fast-moving startup environment where priorities can change quickly and engineers may operate across multiple functions.
    • Experience with model provenance, fingerprinting, watermarking, distillation detection, red-teaming, safety evaluation, interpretability, or related areas is a plus.
    • Experience with activation and representation analysis, probing, model hooks, logits, hidden states, or other model-internals techniques is advantageous.
    • Familiarity with evaluation and inference infrastructure such as DSPy, LiteLLM, Temporal, Ray, vLLM, PostgreSQL/pgvector, or comparable technologies is beneficial.
    • Experience with Next.js, React, TypeScript, data visualization, or experiment dashboards is a plus.
    • Experience running and serving open-weight models on GPUs, including reasoning about latency, throughput, memory, precision, and cost trade-offs, is valuable.
    • Experience designing adversarial evaluations or testing systems against deliberate attempts to evade detection is an advantage.
    • A strong commitment to producing production-quality code, tests, tooling, and documentation that other engineers can confidently operate and extend.

      • Benefits:

      • Opportunity to work on applied machine learning at the intersection of research, experimentation, engineering, and product.
      • End-to-end ownership across model evaluation, model internals, infrastructure, backend systems, and user-facing experiences.
      • Exposure to modern open-weight models, LLM inference systems, and emerging ML verification techniques.
      • A role with significant technical autonomy and the opportunity to shape both experiments and production systems.
      • Fast-moving startup environment with evolving priorities and cross-functional collaboration.
      • Opportunity to translate cutting-edge research into practical, measurable, and user-accessible products.
      • The opportunity to build systems and evaluation methodologies designed to produce evidence that users can understand and trust.
      • Location: Romania.
      • Additional compensation, flexibility, healthcare, and other benefits may be provided according to the partner company's employment package and local arrangements.

data.description:
Odaseva provides enterprise data management and security solutions that help organizations exercise sovereignty over their critical data.
Companies representing 10% of global market capitalization trust Odaseva, including Schneider Electric, Volkswagen and Robert Half.
Its Excalibur Data Platform enables customers to protect, secure, move, and use data and code independently of application vendors.
The platform supports complex and high-volume use cases, including backup, archiving, zero-copy, BCDR & High Availability, data federation, and semantic AI orchestration.
Customer-controlled end-to-end encryption raises the bar for enterprise security.
With 11 patents, Odaseva manages 50 trillion records and supports 100 million users. 

Join Odaseva’s R&D team and help shape the future of our data platform.

We’re a SaaS company specializing in secure data management around Salesforce environments.

You’ll design, build, and optimize scalable data pipelines for large-scale data lake ingestion.


Key Responsibilities

  • Data Pipeline Development & Operations: Design, build, handle, and monitor Spark data pipelines for large-volume data lake ingestion (handling hundreds of TBs).

  • Platform & Cost Optimization: Continuously optimize the performance, reliability, and costs of big data pipelines and infrastructure.

  • Databricks, Snowflake & Cloud Engineering: Deeply leverage Databricks, Snowflake, or AWS Redshift, alongside cloud provider solutions (AWS S3, Glue/Athena, Lambda) for scalable data engineering.

  • Lakehouse Architecture: Demonstrate strong expertise in managing, creating, and optimizing Delta Lake or Apache Iceberg tables.

  • Secure Data Management: Apply security-by-design, data governance, and compliance best practices across storage, compute, and sharing layers.


    • Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience in data engineering or backend data platforms, with at least 3 years of hands-on experience building and operating big data pipelines.

  • Hands-on engineer background with proven track record handling large volumes of data (at least hundreds of TB).

  • Deep knowledge of at least one data lake platform among Databricks, Snowflake, or AWS Redshift.

  • Strong expertise in Apache Spark (creation, handling, and monitoring of pipelines) and lakehouse table formats (Delta Lake or Apache Iceberg).

  • Strong Python or Java and SQL skills, cloud infrastructure (AWS S3, Athena, Glue), and IaC/observability practices.

  • Solid understanding of cost management principles, data security, governance, and data modeling.

  • Equivalent engineering school degree or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, or Applied Mathematics.

  • Fluent in English and French, with clear communication, ownership mindset, and strong collaborative skills.

Airwallex is the only unified payments and financial platform for global businesses. Powered by our unique combination of proprietary infrastructure and software, we empower over 250,000 businesses worldwide – including Brex, Navan, Qantas, SHEIN and many more – with fully integrated solutions to manage everything from business accounts, payments, spend management and treasury, to embedded finance at a global scale.

Proudly founded in Melbourne, we have a team of over 2,300 of the brightest and most innovative people in tech across 27 offices around the globe. Valued at US$11 billion and backed by world-leading investors including T. Rowe Price, Visa, Mastercard, Robinhood Ventures, Sequoia, Salesforce Ventures, DST Global, and Lone Pine Capital, Airwallex is leading the charge in building the global payments and financial platform of the future. If you’re ready to do the most ambitious work of your career, join us.

 

Attributes We Value

We hire successful builders with founder-like energy who want real impact, accelerated learning, and true ownership. You bring strong role-related expertise and sharp thinking, and you’re motivated by our mission and operating principles. You move fast with good judgment, dig deep with curiosity, and make decisions from first principles, balancing speed and rigor.

You're humble and collaborative; turn zero‑to‑one ideas into real products, and you “get stuff done” end-to-end. You use AI to work smarter and solve problems faster. Here, you’ll tackle complex, high‑visibility problems with exceptional teammates and grow your career as we build the future of global banking. If that sounds like you, let’s build what’s next.

 

About the role

 

We are seeking a high-energy, results-driven Strategic Account Manager (SME) to join our team. This is a unique opportunity to become a founding member of our growing Airwallex team in France, specifically focused on scaling our high-growth SME accounts. You will be instrumental in driving expansion, maximising Net Revenue Retention (NRR), and ensuring deep product adoption across a strategic portfolio of 50+ SME accounts. If you are passionate about product, revenue, and impact—and enjoy solving real-world business challenges using technical solutions—this role offers you the chance to make a tangible impact and grow with one of the world’s fastest-growing fintech companies.

 

What you’ll do

 

As a Strategic Account Manager, you will own and develop a portfolio of SME accounts recently signed by our Sales team. Your mission will be to drive expansion through upsell and cross-sell strategies, maximise NRR, and ensure adoption of Airwallex’s product suite. You will work as a critical bridge between customers and our product teams, translating client needs into innovative product solutions and helping to shape our go-to-market approach in France.

 

Responsibilities:

 

  • Drive upsell and cross-sell strategy for your portfolio to exceed quarterly expansion targets and revenue KPIs.

  • Become a power-user of the Airwallex platform and act as a product advisor, recommending optimal API configurations or feature sets based on clients' technical setups.

  • Manage a high-volume portfolio of 50+ accounts, implementing a structured framework to identify and capitalize on high-impact growth opportunities.

  • Partner with Product and Engineering to translate customer requirements into actionable product roadmaps, advocating for client needs in the French market.

  • Help build and refine the Account Management "playbook" for France, ensuring scalable onboarding and activation processes.

  • Proactively monitor account health and product usage metrics to mitigate churn and ensure long-term platform loyalty.

 

Who you are

data.title: Automotive Business Development Director - Premium & Luxury
data.description:
We are growing! We are currently looking to hire an experienced Automotive Business Development Director – Premium & Luxury for our Paris office.  

About CXG: 

Founded in 2006, CXG is a global customer experience company uniquely positioned at the intersection of data-driven retail performance, customer experience transformation, and operational execution across 200+ luxury brands worldwide.  

The mission of our 270 collaborators is to help brands transform customer and employee experiences through tailored insights, strategy, and implementation.  

We are passionate about delivering impact. 

Our clients include the world’s most admired luxury houses, and our solutions combine research, technology, and human expertise to elevate every customer interaction.

Overview

We are currently looking to hire an experienced Automotive Business Development Director – Premium & Luxury, based in our Paris office. This is a strategic and highly commercial role for an entrepreneurial automotive expert who can leverage a strong senior network, create and convert new business opportunities, and help CXG expand its position with leading premium and luxury automotive brands.

What you will be doing

Reporting to CXG Chief Customer Officer, you will lead the commercial development of CXG's Automotive Industry practice. Your responsibilities will include, but will not be limited to, the following:

 1.    Automotive Business Development Leadership

  • Lead the commercial development of CXG's Automotive Industry practice, with direct ownership of new client acquisition and market expansion.
  • Update and maintain a compelling Automotive value proposition that leverages CXG's capabilities, methodologies, resources, differentiators, and data, and addresses the priorities of stakeholders across the industry and regions, including brands, importers, distributors, and showroom management.
  • Promote the value proposition internally and externally and constantly search for new ways to improve it.
  • Serve as CXG's internal and external automotive industry expert and the key point of contact for automotive projects, strategic client discussions, and new business opportunities.
  • Develop and execute a clear commercial strategy to acquire new automotive clients, personally leveraging an established senior network to generate qualified opportunities, build a strong pipeline, and convert prospects into sustainable revenue.
  • Ensure all relevant parties are included in proposal preparation, so the most powerful offers are presented to prospects while taking current and future operational capacity into account.
  • Establish the annual business plan, including revenue ambitions, priority accounts, pipeline targets, key commercial actions, and market development initiatives.
  • Monitor the commercial performance of CXG's Automotive Industry practice, including pipeline development, conversion, and revenue growth, and provide clear reporting to management and the Executive Committee.

2.    Client Development and Internal Expertise

  • New client acquisition sits at the heart of this role. It is the primary criterion and the main measure of success.
  • Create measurable value for both prospects and existing clients by connecting their business priorities with CXG's full range of capabilities.
  • For existing clients, work closely with the CSMs responsible for automotive accounts and join meetings at key milestones, including the presentation of deliverables, discussions about account growth opportunities, and conversations on current client challenges. Use your expertise to strengthen the client dialogue, help resolve issues, and maximize additional business opportunities.
  • Act as the internal subject matter expert for the CSMs managing automotive accounts, sharing relevant market, client, and industry knowledge to strengthen their credibility and effectiveness.
  • Coach CSMs to identify whitespace, develop account expansion plans, and build stronger relationships with senior client stakeholders. Join client meetings whenever your expertise can increase the value of the discussion or support the conversion of an opportunity.
  • Advise clients on CXG's Automotive value proposition, and ensure discussions cover our Measurement, Academy, Customer Insights, and Consulting capabilities.
  • Own the business development effort for the Automotive Industry practice, from market mapping and opportunity creation through proposal development, negotiation, and conversion.
  • Develop and nurture CXG's visibility and credibility across relevant automotive markets through active networking, industry events, thought leadership, and white papers.

Requirements

What you will bring along

This role requires a genuine passion for the automotive and luxury industries.

You should also have the below:

  • Master's degree in Luxury Management, Business Administration, or a related field from a Business School or similar institution.
  • Minimum 10 years of experience in the automotive sector, with significant exposure to consulting, marketing, sales, or business development in the premium or luxury segment.
  • Fluent English is mandatory, with German as a plus and French as a nice-to-have.
  • An extensive and active network of senior decision-makers across the premium and luxury automotive sector, with the credibility and relationship-building skills to open doors, create qualified opportunities, and position CXG's value proposition. This is a core requirement for the role.
  • A strong and demonstrable business development track record, including originating opportunities, managing complex sales cycles, and winning new clients or expanding strategic accounts.
  • Demonstrable experience developing strategic and business plans.
  • Deep knowledge of the premium and luxury automotive market, its commercial ecosystem, client priorities, and the trends and forces shaping the industry's development.
  • Good understanding of corporate finance and measures of performance.
  • Excellent organizational and leadership skills.
  • Positive and outgoing personality.
  • Excellent communication, interpersonal, and presentation skills, polished, persuasive, and diplomatic, with experience in presentations and proposal writing.
  • Outstanding analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • A strong consulting approach and the ability to coach client-facing teams, translate industry expertise into commercial opportunities, and influence senior stakeholders.

data.title: Broker Partnerships Lead
data.description:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

⭐ Your mission

Brokers play a structural role in how large and very large employers select, negotiate, and manage their health and prévoyance coverage. We're looking for a Broker Partnerships Lead to build and animate Alan's relationships with the brokers who operate in the Enterprise segment, turning Alan into a trusted, credible, and commercially compelling partner for those actors, and supporting our Enterprise Sales and Key Account Management teams.

⭐ Location

On-site in Paris, Île-de-France.

What makes this role genuinely unique

  • You'll shape how one of Europe's fastest-growing health insurance companies builds its relationships with the brokers operating in the large and very large employer segment across France, and beyond.

  • You'll have real ownership from day one and operate at the highest levels of the broker market.

  • You'll shape Alan’s broker strategy and execute it. Alan is at an early stage of building this capability. The playbook is yours to define and scale.

  • You'll work directly with Alan's Enterprise Sales, Key Account Management, Insurance, and Executive Leadership.

⭐ Your role

Relationships & Presence

  • Build and maintain trusted, long-term relationships with the brokers that sit between us and the largest employers in our markets (whether private or public), at senior and managing director level.

  • Map the ecosystem, prioritize interlocutors, and design Alan's engagement strategy.

  • Be the consistent Alan voice that brokers recognize: someone who shows up, follows through, and is known as easy to deal with without giving away what shouldn't be given.

Partnership with Alan's Enterprise & Commercial work

  • Be a partner to our Enterprise Sales and KAM teams on every broker situation: drive strategic decisions deal by deal and turn ecosystem knowledge into commercial leverage.

  • Introduce the right broker contacts at the right moment in the commercial cycle, transforming relationship capital into pipeline access on large and very large accounts.

  • Share Alan's value and positioning with broker partners to help them understand, represent, and actively promote Alan within their client portfolios.

  • Hold the line on our non-negotiables while finding creative ways to make the collaboration work for both sides.

Sector Engagement & Anticipation

  • Follow the broker market at deal level and ecosystem level: who is growing, who is consolidating, where portfolio shifts are happening, and what it means for Alan's pipeline and positioning.

  • Be a sharp, early internal voice on where the broker market is heading and on the implications for Alan's strategy, including on consolidation, regulation, and competitive dynamics.

Build & Scale

  • Knowledge base: Build and maintain a knowledge library on broker positions, portfolio footprints, engagement history, and contractual frameworks shared with Enterprise Sales and KAM teams to increase win rates.

  • Framework & tools: Implement processes and AI tools to improve the quality and efficiency of our broker engagement and contract documentation (conventions de courtage, commission tracking, data sharing agreements).

  • Collaboration: Share best practices with the broader Enterprise & Commercial team and contribute proven methodologies to their scaled commercial operations.

  • Market intelligence: Provide competitive intelligence on how brokers position Alan vs. incumbents, how they advise clients on insurer selection, and where we are perceived as "difficult to work with" — and feed that back into product, pricing, and GTM strategy.

⭐ Is it you we’re looking for?

You’ll be a great fit for this opportunity if you:

  • Have at least 8 years of total experience working with or inside the broker ecosystem: at a broker or in an external partnership or distribution role at a health insurer or mutuelle

  • Have legitimate credibility at senior broker level: ability to engage managing director and senior leadership at major brokers as a peer, built through a personal representative past or years of substantive deal-level engagement on the insurer or employer side

  • Have deep knowledge of the broker ecosystem in the large and very large employer segment: how brokers operate, how they are compensated, how they advise clients, and how they influence insurer selection at this scale

  • Have deep understanding of health and prévoyance insurance: the technical dimension (garanties, gestion, régimes, prévoyance) must be native, not learned on the job

  • Have proven ability to build trust with broker counterparts from the insurer or employer side: long-game, trustworthy, discreet, commercially disciplined

  • Demonstrate outstanding stakeholder management: calm, ego-free, able to represent Alan substantively without making it about yourself and equally able to hold firm positions internally when sales pressure pushes toward broker accommodation beyond our framework

  • Demonstrate commercial impact from prior broker-related work: broker relationships that translated into material deal flow, pipeline access, or portfolio migration

  • Are a self-starter: comfortable building from scratch in a fast-paced, high-growth environment with limited process and real autonomy

  • Are ego-free and lever-minded: you accelerate others, you don't seek the spotlight

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the F-H level range.

🙌 Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only.

  • Flexible office with hybrid setup. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Air, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).

  • Transport. Generous transit benefit

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

  • Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture.

  • Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents, for permanent contracts only.

Important note: we hire people, not roles.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success.

If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist.

We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

🔖 Check out our About Alan and Career pages, as well as our Medium, blog and Glassdoor page for more info.

It owns the reporting to all key stakeholders (board, leadership team, tax authorities, and regulators like the ACPR) and ensures that financial data is the single, uncontested source of truth for the company's performance.

⭐️ Your mission ⭐️

We are looking for a rigorous and hands-on accountant to help shape and run Alan's closing production process.

You will be part of our Financial Reporting area, focusing on Financial production. This area ensures that every number in our books is accurate, timely, and trustworthy, and serves as the source of truth for all financial decisions across the company.

Your role will be twofold:

  • Run our key accounting processes: Lead monthly, quarterly, and year-end closings

  • Ensure a feedback loop to drive process improvements, surface anomalies, flag data gaps, and actively contribute to making the closing faster, more automated, and more reliable over time. You will be a key partner to our Financial Operations and Data teams.

  • Accounting review: perform a thorough first-level review of balance sheet and P&L accounts at each close; identify unusual movements, resolve discrepancies, and ensure the overall reliability of the financial statements; build processes (routines, verification files, control procedures)

  • Account and bank reconciliation: maintain clean, up-to-date reconciliations across all balance sheet accounts and entities on a daily basis;

  • Contribute to finance transformation and system improvements: identify manual or repetitive tasks and collaborate with Financial Data to drive automation and reduce closing friction over time ; translate new business streams and P&L lines into accounting (acting as an interface between business teams and Finance)

  • Tax and statutory compliance: prepare and file VAT returns, URSSAF declarations, and other statutory filings accurately and on time; coordinate with external advisors where needed

⭐️ Qualifications ⭐️

Experience and technical skills

  • 4 to 6 years of accounting experience minimum, in an accounting firm or in-house at a fast-paced startup/scale-up

  • Languages: full fluency in French and English

  • Deep command of French accounting standards: VAT rules, URSSAF declarations, bank reconciliation, general ledger management, and month-end close processes

  • Proven ability to own a closing cycle end-to-end, including identifying and resolving issues independently

  • Hands-on experience with an ERP (NetSuite is a strong plus)

  • Comfortable with spreadsheets (Google Sheets or Excel); familiarity with modern accounting tools (Pennylane, Payflows, etc.) is a plus

 

Mindset and soft skills

  • Process-driven: you naturally question how things are done and come with concrete ideas to improve them

  • Curious about automation and tooling; comfortable working in a data-driven environment

  • Clear communicator: you know when to move independently and when to escalate

For this role we are looking to hire within the B0-C0 level range.

🐼 Pourquoi Prévenir

Prévenir est un nouveau Service de Prévention et de Santé au Travail Interentreprises (SPSTI) en Île-de-France.

Notre ambition est de repenser la santé au travail pour améliorer l'impact sur la vie des salariés et l'expérience des professionnels de santé, en s'appuyant sur les moyens technologiques d'Alan.

Notre premier centre médical a ouvert ses portes au 117 Quai de Valmy (Paris 10ᵉ) et ce n'est que le début !

👉 Pour en savoir plus sur le quotidien chez Prévenir, c'est ici

🩺 Le poste, concrètement

Vous êtes médecin du travail référent sur un portefeuille d'entreprises adhérentes, vos responsabilités sont les suivantes:

  • Coordonner les trois missions des SPSTI (suivi individuel, action en milieu de travail, prévention de la désinsertion professionnelle) sur votre périmètre d'entreprises adhérentes, avec une équipe pluridisciplinaire que vous animez : IDEST, ASST, IPRP

  • Innovation et amélioration continue: test et déploiement de nouveaux outils numériques en santé au travail, optimisation des protocoles, collaboration avec les équipes de développement, etc.

Ce qui change vs. un SPSTI classique :

  • Une délégation réelle. L'équipe pluridisciplinaire et les IDEST prennent en charge ce qui peut l'être. Vous concentrez votre temps médical là où il a le plus d'impact.

  • La téléconsultation à la demande du salarié, intégrée à votre pratique quand elle est cliniquement pertinente.

  • Des outils numériques co-construits en fonction de vos attentes. Une équipe d'ingénieurs et de designers Alan développe avec les médecins les outils dont ils ont besoin — DMST, parcours de prévention, assistance à la rédaction de fiche d'entreprises, etc.

Indispensable :

  • Doctorat en médecine + DES ou CES de médecine du travail

Idéalement :

  • Goût pour le travail en équipe pluridisciplinaire et la délégation

  • Curiosité pour les outils numériques et l'IA appliqués à la pratique médicale

  • Capacité à construire une relation de confiance avec salariés et adhérents

Vous ne cochez pas toutes les cases ? Postulez quand même. Médecins en reconversion, jeunes diplômé·es, profils internationaux... n'hésitez pas à nous contacter !

🧑‍💻 Pourquoi nous avons besoin de toi 

Au sein de l’équipe Marketing & Communication, et sous la responsabilité de Pauline, Responsable Communication & Marketing Produit, tu auras pour objectifs principaux de :

  • Satisfaire et engager nos clients en communiquant sur nos innovations, en créant des supports et argumentaires pour nos consultants, et en coordonnant des événements pour notre communauté RH.
  • Augmenter l’adoption de notre produit par nos utilisateurs (les salariés des entreprises clientes de Moka.Care) en créant des visuels percutants et en accompagnant nos consultants sur le terrain.
  • Développer la notoriété de Moka.Care, en contribuant à des campagnes créatives et impactantes, qui valorisent notre expertise et notre raison d’être.
Tu travailleras en collaboration très étroite avec nos consultants qui accompagnent nos clients au quotidien.
 

👉 Tes futures missions 

Engagement clients

  • Animer notre communauté de DRH via des événements premium : Club RH (Take.Care Connect), soirée d'été, webinars clients centrés sur le produit Moka...
  • Partager les nouvelles fonctionnalités et nouvelles offres à nos clients via des newsletters, des emails et des communications dans la plateforme RH.

Engagement utilisateurs

  • Participer aux événements de lancement et stands dans les entreprises pour présenter Moka.Care aux salariés.

Notoriété et thought leadership

  • Produire des contenus (interviews vidéos, pages du site, slides...) pour valoriser nos histoires clients.
  • Participer à l'élaboration de campagnes de marque et d'actions d'influence pour faire rayonner notre expertise auprès de décideurs stratégiques.
 
L'entraide est très importante chez Moka.
De temps en temps, tu prêteras main forte aux autres membres de l'équipe Marketing & Communication sur des projets divers, par exemple : aider à l’organisation d’événements et webinaires de prospection, créer des contenus pour le blog, le site ou Linkedin...

📇 Tu es la personne idéale si

  • Tu disposes d’un bon niveau d’anglais, te permettant de comprendre et traiter des communications professionnelles.

🚀 En nous rejoignant tu vas 

  • Participer à une aventure entrepreneuriale avec une mission forte.
  • Grandir en tant que personne et apprendre au sein d'une équipe humaine, exigeante et solidaire.

  • Aller sur le terrain, à la rencontre des utilisateurs et futurs utilisateurs de Moka.Care.

data.description:
Why Harvey

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.

Role Overview

As Harvey scales its pre-sales function across EMEA, we are hiring a Legal Engineer Manager to lead and grow the team in Paris. This role exists to provide senior leadership and strategic direction to a team of Legal Engineers who sit at the heart of Harvey's commercial motion - bringing legal credibility, product expertise, and consultative support to law firm and in-house prospects.

Harvey’s Legal Engineers are skilled lawyers from top-tier law firms who apply their legal experience to ensure that current and prospective customers understand how Harvey’s solutions enhance specific day-to-day workflows, working alongside Harvey’s Account Executives to support all aspects of our sales strategy. Legal Engineers build consultative relationships with law firm partners and associates and in-house attorneys at private equity firms and Fortune 500 companies, becoming trusted advisors on how Harvey’s AI solutions can make them more effective.

Similar to the way Solutions Architects secure the “technical win” in the sales process, Legal Engineers secure the “legal win” by performing in-depth customer discovery and education on Harvey’s solutions through targeted meetings and demos that resonate with the customer’s day-to-day workflows specific to their legal practice area.

Legal Engineers utilize their experience practicing law and their legal mindset to ask thoughtful questions to understand the needs of law firm and in-house attorneys, develop credibility, and then partner with Account Executives to educate them on Harvey’s value via large and small group sessions as well as one-to-one conversations.

What You'll Do

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of Legal Engineers, setting clear performance expectations and building a high-trust, high-output team culture

  • Own the quality and consistency of Harvey's pre-sales legal engineering function, ensuring demos, discovery conversations, and deal support are delivered to the highest standard

  • Partner closely with Account Executives and GTM leadership to prioritise pipeline, develop deal strategy, and support conversion on complex or strategic opportunities

  • Engage with lawyers at prospective customers to understand and address their workflow challenges

  • Collaborate with Product and Marketing to ensure the team's field insights are feeding into positioning, roadmap, and go-to-market strategy

  • Lead product demonstrations tailored to the context of various law firm practice groups and in-house legal teams, asking questions to validate how Harvey can add value and then showcasing Harvey’s features and benefits relevant to each prospective client’s potential use cases.

  • Act as the “Voice of the Customer,” using your legal perspective to help the broader sales team to develop and implement more effective strategies and synthesize customer feedback for the product team through a legal lens.

  • Travel may be required from time to time, including visits to customer office locations and company offices.


What You Have

  • Qualified lawyer with 7+ PQE, with experience in a law firm or in-house legal environment

  • Must have prior experience managing a team, with a track record of developing talent and driving performance

  • Deep familiarity with legal technology and AI tools, with an ability to quickly develop and demonstrate platform expertise

  • Strong commercial instincts and the ability to engage credibly with senior stakeholders at law firms and in-house legal teams

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with experience running training, workshops, or client-facing product sessions

  • Comfort operating in a fast-paced, high-growth environment with a pragmatic, solutions-oriented approach

data.title: CDI - MODELISTE FLOU ET/OU TAILLEUR (H/F)
data.description:
LA MAISON JACQUEMUS
 
Jacquemus a été fondée par Simon Porte Jacquemus en 2009 à Paris, en France.
Dédiée à la mémoire de la mère du créateur, la marque puise son inspiration dans une passion pour la culture. Les collections femme et homme font référence à l'art de vivre à la française et aux gestes universels de beauté, intégrant des influences allant de la photographie d'art aux arts décoratifs, en passant par le cinéma, la peinture et la sculpture.
 
Au fil des années, Jacquemus a mis en scène ses défilés dans des lieux uniques et inattendus, notamment une piscine parisienne, le Musée Picasso, un champ de lavande en Provence, un champ de blé aux abords de Paris, un marais salant en Camargue et une plage à Hawaï. Plus récemment, la marque a investi des lieux tels que le canal du Château de Versailles (Le Chouchou), la Fondation Maeght (Les Sculptures), la Casa Malaparte (La Casa) et l'appartement parisien d'Auguste Perret (La Croisière).
 
Basé dans le 8ᵉ arrondissement de Paris, Jacquemus est une maison de mode indépendante comptant plus de 300 employés. Réputée pour sa forte présence numérique et son expansion internationale, la marque a développé des expériences de vente innovantes à travers le monde avant d'ouvrir son premier flagship permanent au 58 Avenue Montaigne à Paris en 2022. Les collections femme et homme font référence à l'art de vivre à la française et aux gestes universels de beauté, intégrant des influences allant de la photographie d'art aux arts décoratifs, en passant par le cinéma, la peinture et la sculpture.

  • Represent Tandem externally in meetings, events, and conferences, positioning us as a trusted digital health partner.

  • Bring the voice of the market back into Tandem, sharing insights that inform product development, regulatory priorities, and local go-to-market strategy.

  • Help build the customer success and support infrastructure that ensures our partners thrive with Tandem.

What You Bring

  • Proven experience with healthcare partnerships, sales, or business development - ideally in health-tech, med-tech, with familiarity of the hospital ecosystem

  • A strong track record of closing strategic partnerships in complex, regulated environments with providers, EHRs, or pharmaceutical companies.

  • Deep knowledge of the French hospital ecosystem - from payors and providers to health IT vendors and regional nuances.

  • A strong local network and ability to build trusted relationships across stakeholder groups.

  • Comfortable navigating clinical, commercial, and technical conversations.

  • Fluent in French and English, with excellent communication skills.

  • Independent operator with the ability to collaborate closely with cross-functional teams.

  • Passion for improving healthcare delivery through thoughtful, impactful innovation.

Bonus Points

  • Experience working with or selling into EHR providers, health systems, or care delivery platforms.

  • Background in medtech, digital health, healthcare

  • Familiarity with EU/French regulatory and compliance environments.

  • Experience in startup or high-growth environments, especially launching new markets.


What we offer

  • Competitive salary, reviewed as you grow, plus stock options

  • 30 days of holiday

Location

We believe the best ideas happen when we’re together. This is a full-time role based in Paris, France. You’ll travel regularly - either to meet clinicians around France or to collaborate with our team in Stockholm.

Culture at Tandem

At Tandem, we move fast, think big, and take ownership. We're a high-performing, diverse team with a shared drive to change the future of healthcare - and we’re just getting started.

Our culture is built on action, ambition, and learning. You'll be trusted to take the lead, challenge yourself, and make an impact from day one. We believe real growth happens when you're stretched, supported, and surrounded by smart, passionate teammates who want to win together.

Even though we’re spread across countries, we come together often in Sweden for team meetings, social events, and offsites - blending global reach with real human connection.

We hire for talent, potential, and attitude - valuing different backgrounds and fresh perspectives. Great ideas come from everywhere, and we’re building a team that reflects the world we want to change.

data.title: Finance Business Partner
data.description:
About Everfield

Everfield buys, builds, and grows European vertical market and specialist software companies, providing them with the tools they need to move to the next level. Our mission is to foster ambition, fuel growth, and unlock opportunities for Europe's software ecosystem.

Companies in the Everfield ecosystem follow a decentralised model, maintaining their team, brand, and offices, while focusing on what they do best - building products and supporting customers. Everfield provides support in talent acquisition, HR, and access to a team of experts in building and growing European B2B SaaS companies who consult on financial and operational topics. Founded in 2022, Everfield has an ecosystem presence in 9 countries, and growing.

About the Role

This is not a reporting role. It's ownership of the financial engine for a portfolio of growing software businesses.

You'll be accountable end-to-end for the accounting integrity of your portfolio: closing the books accurately, building and leading a team of local finance experts to meet French statutory and regulatory requirements, and making sure every number that reaches Everfield's leadership is right and on time. But the job doesn't stop at accuracy. You'll sit next to Business Unit Leaders as their financial conscience and commercial sparring partner - coaching them on the numbers, challenging their growth plans, and pushing them to allocate resources where they'll actually compound.

Everfield deliberately gives this role more scope than a typical FP&A or controller seat carries at this career stage. You'll run the accounting, build and lead the regional finance team, and shape how each business thinks about growth - the full stack, across multiple companies.

What You'll Do

Own the numbers

• Be accountable for the accuracy and timeliness of monthly reporting (management P&L, KPIs, operating metrics) for each business in your portfolio - not just its preparation.

• Build and manage a team of local financial experts to meet French statutory and regulatory compliance requirements.

• Guide each business's finance and accounting team through migration onto Everfield's NetSuite instance.

• Own the accuracy and timeliness of the underlying accounting work behind every number you report.

• Build and defend annual budgets and rolling forecasts, incorporating strategic initiatives and long-term expectations.

• Prepare Quarterly Update Review (QUR) packs for Everfield's CEO, CFO, and COO.

Drive the growth agenda

• Coach Business Unit Leaders on financial acumen - make sure they understand and consistently apply the Everfield ratios, not just report against them.

• Challenge and support Business Unit Leaders in applying Everfield's prescribed revenue system to their business.

• Help each business spot operating efficiencies, report headcount accurately, and manage overhead with intent.

• Partner with Business Unit Leaders on charting expense management and aligning resources toward growth, not just cost control.

• Play an active role in integration of newly acquired businesses - systems, data, and reporting design, alongside the Integration Director and Head of BI.

• Partner with your Strategic Business Partner (SBP) counterpart on the day-to-day relationship with each business in your region.

Who We're Looking For

• An ambitious problem-solver who wants this role to be a stepping stone – experience on the path towards a CFO or Controller of a larger group of companies, or of a larger standalone business.

• Strong technical grounding in accounting practices and controls - you can run a clean close and hold a third-party provider to a standard, not just review their output.

• Commercial instinct to match: you can sit across from a Business Unit Leader and challenge their growth plan, not just report on whether they hit it.

• A completed university education plus a professional finance qualification (CA/ACA/CIMA or equivalent).

• 5+ years in Business Controlling, FP&A, or Finance Business Partnering.

• Ability to lead and build a team of regional finance specialists.

• Comfort operating in a decentralised, multi-entity, PE-backed environment - you'll manage stakeholders across businesses at very different stages of maturity.

• Fluent in English and French; effective communicator at every level of an organisation, from bookkeeper to CEO.

• Ideally, a background in fast-growing technology or SaaS companies.

• Willingness to travel occasionally.

What We Offer

• Attractive salary package with performance-based bonus.

• Remote flexibility.

• A collaborative team culture based on respect, ownership, and trust.

• Access to international experts within the Everfield ecosystem - accelerate your personal and professional growth.

• Regular team events and company celebrations.

Interview Process

Here's what to expect and who you'll meet during the recruitment process:

• First interview with Talent Acquisition Manager (0.5 h)

• Second interview with Hiring Manager (1.0 h)

• Third interview with Group Finance representatives (1.0 h)

We are an equal opportunity employer and ensure that no applicant is subject to less favourable treatment on the grounds of gender, gender identity, marital status, race, colour, nationality, ethnicity, age, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, responsibilities for dependants, physical or mental disability. Any hiring decision is made based on skills, qualifications and experiences.

We look forward to receiving your application!

data.title: ML Engineer - Power
data.description:
At Kpler, we are dedicated to helping our clients navigate complex markets with ease. By simplifying global trade information and providing valuable insights, we empower organisations to make informed decisions in commodities, energy, and maritime sectors.
 
Since our founding in 2014, we have focused on delivering top-tier intelligence through user-friendly platforms. Our team of over 850 experts from 69 countries works tirelessly to transform intricate data into actionable strategies, ensuring our clients stay ahead in a dynamic market landscape. Join us to leverage cutting-edge innovation for impactful results and experience unparalleled support on your journey to success.
 

About the Role

As a Machine Learning Engineer at Kpler, you will play a key role in developing and deploying predictive models that power our global commodity, energy, and maritime intelligence platforms. Working closely with Data Scientists, Data Engineers, and Product teams, you will bridge the gap between machine learning experimentation and production-grade software delivery. Your work will directly transform complex data flows into real-time, actionable insights that help world-leading trading firms, industrial leaders, and analysts make critical decisions.


Key Responsibilities

  • Architect and deploy ML pipelines: Design, build, and maintain production-grade machine learning workflows and microservices for power market forecasting and electricity grid modeling.

  • Bridge research and engineering: Transition statistical and machine learning prototypes from initial experimentation into scalable, production-ready Python applications.

  • Manage time-series and event data systems: Design and optimize database schemas in PostgreSQL to handle high-throughput time-series data, event streams, and normalization routines.

  • Implement robust MLOps practices: Establish automated model training, backtesting, evaluation, tuning, and feature/model versioning standards across deployments.

  • Drive data engineering quality: Construct clean ingestion and transformation pipelines, ensuring high integrity, validation, and low-latency access across analytical models.

  • Champion software excellence: Write modular, well-tested Python code, actively participating in peer code reviews, CI/CD automation, and Agile delivery processes.


    • Experience & Background
    What you'll need (Must-haves)

    • Software engineering foundation: Approximately two to five years of experience as a data-focused software engineer.

    • Python mastery: Significant experience working with large production Python codebases, rather than working exclusively in notebooks.

    • Domain knowledge: Deep understanding of electricity-grid fundamentals, including generation, transmission, and electricity markets.

    • Data engineering & databases: Experience in data engineering, including working with PostgreSQL or similar databases, database design, data normalisation, and managing time-series and event data.

    • DS & ML research rigor: Proven experience in data science and machine learning research, encompassing statistics, hypothesis testing, model training, evaluation, backtesting, tuning, and model selection.

    • MLOps & versioning: Practical experience in machine learning engineering, specifically including model and feature versioning.

    • Engineering practices & communication: Confidence working with Git, code reviews, and Agile methodologies, supported by strong written and spoken English.

      • Nice-to-haves

      • Cloud platforms: Experience deploying ML workloads on AWS or GCP using Docker and Kubernetes.

      • Workflow orchestration: Familiarity with orchestration tools such as Apache Airflow, Kubeflow, or MLflow.

      • Streaming technologies: Exposure to real-time streaming architectures (e.g., Apache Kafka).

data.title: Senior Full-Stack Product Engineer
data.description:
About Us

Base360.ai is the AI operating system for short-term rental businesses, helping property managers run their operations on autopilot.

Born out of The Flex, a short-term rental operator that scaled to an eight-figure business using its own software, Base360.ai is now launching as a standalone platform for short-term rental operators worldwide.

We bring reservations, guest communication, pricing, payments, cleaning, maintenance, and reporting into one platform—helping operators automate manual work, reduce costs, increase revenue, and scale their portfolios.

We're looking for an ambitious Senior Full-Stack Product Engineer who wants to turn real customer problems into intuitive, reliable software. You'll work closely with founders, designers, and operators to identify what matters, build solutions, and improve them based on how people use them.

If you enjoy owning the full journey from customer problem to shipped product—and you're excited by AI, automation, and short-term rentals—we want to meet you.

What You'll Build

As a Senior Full-Stack Product Engineer, you'll help shape and scale Base360.ai across the entire short-term rental lifecycle.

You'll build customer-facing features, operational dashboards, automation engines, AI-powered workflows, and integrations that help property managers grow without increasing their workload at the same rate.

Your work will connect what users see with the systems behind it—from a guest’s check-in experience to the workflows coordinating reservations, cleaning, payments, and owner reporting.

Your Mission

Understand Customer Problems

Work directly with property managers and internal teams to understand their workflows, identify friction, and decide which problems are worth solving.

Build Products End-to-End

Take features from idea and prototype through frontend, backend, integrations, testing, and deployment. Own the complete experience and how it performs in production.

Create Intuitive User Experiences

Work with designers to make complex short-term rental operations easy to manage. Build interfaces that help users complete tasks quickly and confidently.

Create Powerful Automations

Build event-driven workflows that eliminate repetitive work—from scheduling cleaning after a booking to sending check-in instructions and generating owner statements.

Develop AI-Powered Features

Use LLMs and AI agents to automate guest communication, triage maintenance requests, support pricing decisions, and help operators manage their portfolios more efficiently.

Connect the Ecosystem

Build reliable APIs and integrations with platforms including Airbnb, Hostaway, Stripe, Twilio, OpenAI, Google, and other partners across the short-term rental ecosystem.

Solve Real Operational Problems

Build solutions for:

  • Real-time reservation and availability synchronization

  • Dynamic pricing intelligence

  • Smart lock access and key management

  • Automated guest communication across channels

  • Guest check-in and upsell journeys

  • Operational forecasting

  • Cleaning and maintenance automation

  • Owner reporting and financial workflows

  • AI-powered monitoring and alerts

Measure and Improve

Use customer feedback, product usage, and operational results to evaluate what you ship. Improve features based on adoption, time saved, fewer errors, and better user outcomes.

Build for Scale

Make sound technical decisions that balance delivery speed, maintainability, security, and reliability as more operators and properties join the platform.

Tech Stack

We care more about capability than specific technologies, but our current stack includes:

  • Python

  • FastAPI

  • React

  • TypeScript

  • Supabase

  • PostgreSQL

  • AWS

  • Serverless architecture

  • OpenAI APIs

  • Twilio

  • Stripe

  • Docker

  • GitHub Actions

You Might Be a Great Fit If You Have

  • Strong experience building and shipping production software

  • The ability to work across frontend and backend systems

  • Experience with React, TypeScript, Python, FastAPI, or similar technologies

  • Strong understanding of APIs, databases, integrations, and cloud architecture

  • A product mindset and curiosity about why users need a feature

  • Good judgment around usability, scope, and technical trade-offs

  • The ability to turn an ambiguous problem into a practical, working solution

  • Confidence working directly with customers, designers, and founders

  • The ability to work independently and own outcomes

  • Curiosity about AI, automation, and operational efficiency

  • A bias toward shipping, learning, and iterating

Bonus points for experience with:

  • Short-term rentals, hospitality technology, or property management systems

  • Multi-tenant SaaS platforms

  • Marketplace businesses and booking channel integrations

  • AI agents and workflow automation

  • Product analytics and experimentation

  • Event-driven architectures

  • Supabase

  • AWS serverless infrastructure

What Success Looks Like

Within your first 12 months:

  • You've shipped features that property managers actively use

  • Core short-term rental workflows are automated through products you've built

  • Customers spend less time on manual administration and repetitive tasks

  • Complex workflows become easier to understand and complete

  • Integrations move reservations, availability, payments, and operational data reliably

  • AI-powered features become part of customers’ everyday operations

  • Customer feedback and usage data consistently inform your product decisions

  • Your work helps operators grow their portfolios, improve guest experiences, and operate more profitably

Why Join Us

Build Something Meaningful

Solve problems experienced daily by short-term rental operators, with direct access to The Flex’s operations to test ideas and see their impact.

Own the Product Outcome

Help decide what to build, how it should work, and how to measure its success. Take responsibility for features from the first conversation through ongoing improvement.

Small Team, Massive Opportunity

Work closely with the founders and directly influence the product and technical direction of Base360.ai.

Learn Faster

Solve real-world challenges across product, software, AI, automation, hospitality operations, and scale.

Performance-Based Rewards

Competitive compensation with substantial upside for exceptional performers.

Remote-First

Work from anywhere. We care about outcomes, not hours.

This Role Is Not For You If

  • You're looking for a slow-paced corporate environment

  • You want a narrowly defined role with limited customer or product involvement

  • You need detailed specifications before you can make progress

  • You avoid ownership and accountability

  • You consider a feature finished without checking whether it solves the user’s problem

We're looking for someone who wants to help build the AI operating system for the short-term rental industry.

#LI-Remote
